description: The file defines the CallLocation class within the Goteo project, extending a base LocationItem class, and provides methods for permission checks and retrieval related to call location entities.

classes.name: CallLocation
classes.description: Represents the location information of a call, extending LocationItem, with added methods for permission checks and retrieval based on call identifiers.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object by calling the parent constructor and setting the call property.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Static method to retrieve a CallLocation instance based on a Call object or call ID.

methods.name: userCanView
methods.description: Checks whether a given user has permission to view this call location.

methods.name: userCanEdit
methods.description: Checks whether a given user has permission to edit this call location.
